messages:
arya: Penelope requested a compact provenance package for INC-2026-0801 focusing on KMS access patterns, PutKeyPolicy history +/-24h, and RBAC diffs; who can own?
audit-bot: Checklist: include key ARNs, CloudTrail entries for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/PutKeyPolicy/AssumeRole, kube-audit snippets, exporter identity, tar.gz SHA256, detached GPG sig, manifest.json mapping files->sha256->exporter, and control_map (SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.9.2.1).
noah: I can gather CloudTrail and KMS outputs. Quick Q: require list-grants and describe-key outputs?
auditor-penelope: Yes to both. Also export an access graph (GraphML) and a CSV of principals->permissions. Include STS:GetCallerIdentity before any presign and the CloudTrail PutObject reference.
arya: Plan: 1) filter CloudTrail for events in window 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z - 2026-07-01T04:00:00Z 2) aws kms describe-key/get-key-policy/list-grants 3) kubectl get rolebinding diffs + kube-audit 4) iam_graph -> .graphml + .csv 5) tarball + sha256 + gpg sig, upload to s3 evidence bucket with Object Lock and tag evidence:INC-2026-0801 6) include manifest.json with exported_by, exported_at, presign_creator, presign_created_at, time_window, control_map, gpg_fingerprint.
infra-oncall: When uploading, call sts:GetCallerIdentity and save output; set Object Lock retention 30d and record PutObject S3 key in manifest. Do not paste presigned URL in Slack.
noah: Commands I'll run:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-07-01T04:00:00Z" > ct_encrypt.json
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/bb224466 > kms_describe.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/bb224466 > kms_grants.json
kubectl get rolebinding -n prod my-app -o yaml > my-app_binding_after.yaml
python tools/iam_graph.py --keys key_arns.txt --output inc0801_access.graphml --csv inc0801_access.csv
```
arya: We'll add a short timeline.md correlating KMS events with RoleBinding changes and pod events; include triage notes and ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0801.
noah: Packaging steps:
```
tar czf inc0801_evidence_v1.tar.gz ct_*.json kms_*.json my-app_binding_after.yaml inc0801_access.graphml inc0801_access.csv kube-audit.json timeline.md
sha256sum inc0801_evidence_v1.tar.gz > inc0801.sha256
gpg --output inc0801.sig --detach-sign --local-user compliance@redwood-internal inc0801_evidence_v1.tar.gz
```
noah: Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0801/ with Object Lock set; presign created, presign_identity.json saved. Manifest summary: files: ct_encrypt.json, ct_decrypt.json, ct_assumerole.json, kms_describe.json, kms_grants.json, key_policy.json, my-app_binding_after.yaml, inc0801_access.graphml, inc0801_access.csv, kube-audit.json, timeline.md, inc0801_evidence_v1.tar.gz, inc0801.sha256, inc0801.sig; exported_by: noah@redwood.com; exported_at: 2026-07-01T05:12:03Z; presign_creator: noah@redwood.com; presign_created_at: 2026-07-01T05:14:10Z; control_map: ["SOC2 CC6.2","ISO27001 A.9.2.1"]; gpg_fingerprint: "0F12 AB34 CDEF 5678 90AB CDEF 1234 5678"
auditor-penelope: Received package. I'll validate SHA256 + GPG sig and request raw CloudTrail S3 objects if deeper validation needed. Please prepare a short narrative if I ask for correlation of Pod lifecycle with KMS calls. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
arya: Thanks all. I'll mark evidence:INC-2026-0801/v1 as delivered in the tracker and prepare the narrative if requested.
